task.title: M9: Layer view (topologically sorted module bands with violations highlighted)
task.description:
A view that answers whether the codebase is layered and where the layering leaks. Condense strongly connected components of the module-level graph (cycles become one band), topologically sort, and draw modules as horizontal bands from most-depended-upon at the bottom to entry points at the top. Edges pointing downward are normal and drawn faintly; any edge that would point upward (only possible inside a condensed cycle) and any module in a multi-member SCC is highlighted. Modules in the same band are laid out side by side. Clicking a module shows its in and out edges. In compare mode, highlight bands that changed membership and edges that newly cross bands in the wrong direction. Uses the existing module edges only; no new analysis.

Acceptance criteria:
- A 'Layers' view selectable from the view switcher; hash param view=layers; works on the static export.
- workbook renders with Go packages and TS dirs in bands; the cycles currently reported by the Graph view appear as merged bands marked as cycles.
- Hidden files/folders are respected; module labels are readable at 1280px width with at least 30 modules.
- One test for the condensation plus topological ordering helper.
